fixed_train_window_rule: one hash-minimum window per source document; select first 64 document windows by hash
fixed_validation_window_rule: up to two hash-minimum windows per validation document; report equal-document and equal-window means
checkpoint_selection: lowest fixed validation equal-document mean at scheduled evaluation; tie goes to earlier step
divergence_abort: non-finite loss/gradient/parameter/state, fixed train loss above 2x initial, or fixed validation document-balanced loss above initial plus 0.5
resource_guards: reuse scratch/run.py preflight and live guard_reasons without changed thresholds
sealed_test_policy: never open test.sealed.jsonl or evaluate test loss during pilot
